title: solder2
description: A station at a fixed position on the shopfloor that realises one service. Each of its Actions runs one recipe: it produces the recipe's output product at the station's own position, but only while every input product of that recipe already lies at the station. The Actions themselves differ per station and are given in the instance Thing Descriptions.

produceCommunicationModule.title: produce communicationModule
produceCommunicationModule.description: Run the communicationModule recipe: consume comm, mainboard2 and place communicationModule at this station. Has no effect unless every input already lies at the station.

produceMainModule.title: produce mainModule
produceMainModule.description: Run the mainModule recipe: consume cpu, flash, mainboard, ram and place mainModule at this station. Has no effect unless every input already lies at the station.

produceSensorModule.title: produce sensorModule
produceSensorModule.description: Run the sensorModule recipe: consume mainboard3, sensor and place sensorModule at this station. Has no effect unless every input already lies at the station.
